S50U26.today_summary: 1073.1 on the September future, +1.5 points, sits 3.1 points above a max pain frozen at 1070 for a seventh straight session. Net dealer gamma is negative from 950 through 1090 with a -6.6k baht/point cumulative trough at 1070 and only crosses zero at 1100, leaving spot 27 points (2.9 sigma) inside short-gamma territory. The live walls are 1100 calls (2,830 OI, 217 lots today) and 1050 puts (1,761 OI, 317 lots - the heaviest strike on the board), while the 910 put wall's 15,892 OI took 11 lots 163 points away and reads as legacy structure. ATM IV 13.71% prices a 9.26-point day, making the 1050-1100 corridor a 5.4 sigma box.
what_changed: Put OI added 3,974 contracts (+11.2%) over 5 sessions to 39,347 while call OI added only 1,120 (+6.5%) to 18,424, lifting P/C OI to a 7-session high 2.14 from 2.04 on 8/19.
ATM IV eased to 13.71% from 14.44% on 8/24, giving back the spike from that -10.0 point session; the 1 sigma daily move is 9.26 points vs 8.78 on 8/19.
Total volume collapsed to 2,422 contracts from 4,928 on 8/24, a 51% drop, with the 1050 put taking 317 of it - the single heaviest strike today.
Gamma flip held 1100 for a third straight session after sitting at 1110 on 8/19-8/20, tracking the call wall's migration from 1080 to 1100 on 8/20.
S50U26.five_day_thesis: The future is +0.3 points net over 5 sessions (1072.8 on 8/19 to 1073.1) inside a 14.5-point range, and max pain has not drifted a single tick off 1070 across all 7 sessions on file. What moved is the burden map: put OI is up 3,974 contracts (+11.2%) to 39,347 against 1,120 added calls, pushing P/C OI to a 7-session high of 2.14 - insurance demand, not a directional bet. The call wall migrated 1080 to 1100 on 8/20 and has held since, pulling the gamma flip down from 1110 to 1100 and leaving spot 27 points inside dealer short-gamma territory. ATM IV round-tripped 12.99 to 14.44 to 13.71 across the window, so there has been no durable compression to sell into and no expansion confirming a break. Net: a frozen anchor under a thickening downside hedge stack - range-persistent while 1050 holds, convex lower if it does not.

strategies.name: Iron condor 1020/1040 put x 1110/1130 call
strategies.rationale: The 1050 put wall and 1100 call wall are both Vol2Vol-confirmed today (317 and 217 lots), boxing a 50-point corridor that is 5.4x the 9.26-point 1 sigma daily move, and both short strikes sit outside those live walls.
strategies.defined_risk: Max loss = 20-point wing width minus roughly 6.1 points net credit (1040/1020 put ~2.9 + 1110/1130 call ~3.2 at mid) = about 13.9 points on the breached side.
strategies.invalidation: A close beyond 1050 (put wall and deepest short-gamma strike) or 1100 (call wall and gamma flip).

strategies.name: 1050/1020 put debit spread
strategies.rationale: Below 1050 dealers are short gamma at every strike down to 1020 (-1.72k, -1.25k, -1.20k baht/point at 1050/1040/1030), so a break there is hedged with the move rather than against it, and the 1040 put's 14.34% IV is the cheapest part of the put surface.
strategies.defined_risk: Max loss = net debit of about 4.8 points (1050 put ~9.9 mid minus 1020 put ~5.1 mid); maximum value 30 points at or below 1020.
strategies.invalidation: A reclaim of 1085 (the 8/17 swing high) with the future holding above the 1080 long-gamma shelf (+2.5k baht/point).

strategies.name: 1100/1120 call credit spread
strategies.rationale: The 1100 short strike sits on both the largest call OI on the board (2,830, 217 lots today) and the gamma flip, above which dealer hedging turns damping - the standalone upside wing for a book unwilling to carry the put side while protection OI is still building.
strategies.defined_risk: Max loss = 20-point width minus roughly 4.35 points credit (1100 call ~7.75 mid minus 1120 call ~3.4 mid) = about 15.65 points.
strategies.invalidation: A daily close above 1100 with strike volume expanding beyond today's 217 lots.

S50U26.prediction: Base case is continued rotation inside 1050-1100 with 1070 as the anchor: 9.26 points of 1 sigma means a 27-point trip to the call wall requires a 2.9 sigma session. A sustained trade below 1050 flips the read - that is the deepest short-gamma strike on the board at -1.72k baht/point, and dealer hedging would sell into the break toward 1030/1020. Above 1100 the cumulative gamma sign turns positive and upside should decelerate rather than extend.
S50U26.risk_note: Educational analysis only - not trade advice, and no position sizing is implied. SET50 options are European and cash-settled on the SET50 index, so no share delivery ever forces hedging into expiry: the 1070 max-pain anchor is a tendency, not a magnet with teeth, and pinning here is structurally weaker than for physically-settled single stocks - weaker still at 35 DTE. Defined-risk is not low-risk: the condor's ~13.9-point max loss is real and short-vol payoffs are negatively skewed, small frequent gains against rare large losses. If price leaves the 1050-1100 corridor on expanding volume and rising IV, real flow is beating the option structure and the mean-reversion read should be dropped rather than averaged into.
